goal: Define strict versioned records, immutable references, canonical digests, and authorization rules for every later M1 component.
non_goals: compatibility with the prototype local ledger

acceptance.statement: Every record includes schema, kind, project and subject identity, stable operation_id, and precise references.
Canonical encoding produces deterministic SHA-256 digests and rejects duplicate or unknown fields.
Authorization derives from verified GitHub identity and policy, never an actor string supplied by an Agent.
Approval binds the exact candidate digest; a newer unapproved candidate cannot supersede it.
Contract records exclude milestone, dependency, progress, and delivery facts owned by GitHub native objects.
No persistent local fact source is introduced.

parent_revision.disposition: superseded by v2 to add explicit impact surface risks and acceptance environment

impact_surface: all later M1 record encoders and validators

risks.risk: Ambiguous canonicalization could make identical facts hash differently.
risks.mitigation: Specify deterministic key ordering and golden vectors.
Keep identity inputs typed as verified gateway facts and test rejection of actor strings.
